items.title: Old Monk maker’s revenue halves in H1 on sales curbs
items.description: In the first half of this fiscal year, Mohan Meakin's operations revenue took a heavy hit, plummeting by 64% to ₹288 crore. This downturn follows the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India halting sales of specific Old Monk variants due to concerns over their classification. While the company is contesting the order, it will also modify product labels to comply.
